reason: R79 max_lost=1 was bit-identical to the BDD baseline; the first effective Lost reappearance needs a larger frame gap in the current tracker lifecycle.
hypothesis: Allow only the first eligible Lost reappearance on BDD with max_lost=2, rather than max_lost=3 in R78; this may reduce false reactivations while preserving some genuine ones.
data: Reuse R78 UA dev12; BDD COCO-video val200, R74 cache/GT/evaluator, three seeds 0/1/2
decision_rule: Select only if BDD mean IDSW <=6102.8 (within 10% of EKF 5548), mean HOTA and IDF1 each no more than 0.5 percentage point below PF R74, and UA R78 quality gate remains satisfied. Otherwise stop this Lost-window line and keep defaults unchanged.
limitations: BDD val has already been inspected in R61/R74/R78/R79; this is exploratory, not an independent benchmark. PF-specific association makes an algorithm-level variant, not a pure motion-filter comparison.
